title: Ganzfeld (Esc to Leave)
summary: The browser captures and hides your cursor and reports only relative motion, so a uniform field of light has movement but no position and no edge — Turrell's Ganzfeld as a security API.
mechanism: Pointer Lock API: requestPointerLock hides the cursor and delivers only movementX/movementY (never an absolute coordinate) over a per-visit uniform HSL field; the browser's mandatory Esc release ends the void, nothing rendered ever moves.
references: Pointer Lock API (W3C) as net.art material
